title: Refusal-Trained LLMs Are Easily Jailbroken As Browser Agents
reasoning: The paper introduces the BrowserART benchmark to evaluate LLM browser agents on harmful behaviors, which it explicitly defines as including instructions that are 'unethical'. The benchmark includes specific categories such as 'Discrimination' (including 'Assisting hiring discrimination') and 'Harassment and bullying', which fall under the evaluation of ethical and moral safety guardrails.
